source: User-provided real camera image attachments, cropped views of their three-lamp fixture
ground_truth: User explicitly identified first image as red and second as green
scope: Three user-supplied regression images, one with preexisting overlay. Their capture independence is not verified; transformations/crops are correlated checks, not field accuracy. No all-off or yellow-on real photos were provided.

additional_sample.source: User-supplied screenshot explicitly labeled red-on by the user. Contains preexisting pink/red rectangle and Chinese red-light text; these are not detector evidence.
additional_sample.derived_crop_note: Crop inside overlay removes every drawn rectangle edge and text. It is a correlated derivative, not a new real capture.
